fields.body_en:
Medication Administration Verification

By checking the box below, I acknowledge that I have verified all aspects of medication management for this period.
I have verified that all medications have an active prescription on file; all medications on site are accurate to the prescription;
and that the Natural Support has given the prescribed medications and as‑needed medications for the correct purpose and in accordance
with instructions from the prescriber (Right Person, Medication, Dose, Purpose, Time, Route, Frequency). The person receiving the medication
was monitored for side effects and documentation completed as needed. All medical personnel were notified as needed.
